[Feb 29 2024 Adapting to Change: Exploring the Intersection of Tradition and Innovation in Insurance with TJ Hooper In this conversation, Matthew Vega-Sanz interviews TJ Hooper from Hooper Agency, a second-generation insurance agency. They discuss various topics related to the insurance industry, including the evolution of the agency, the importance of customer service, the use of virtual assistants, and the impact of AI on the industry. TJ shares his insights and experiences, highlighting the need for flexibility and adaptability in the changing market. He also acknowledges the potential benefits and concerns of AI in insurance. [Feb 27 2024 AI in Insurance: Navigating Efficiency and Humanity with Boss Fetty In this episode, host Matthew Vega-Sanz interviews Boss Fetty, an insurance agency owner, about his journey in the insurance industry and the role of artificial intelligence (AI) in insurance. Boss shares how he started in insurance and his transition from working at State Farm to becoming an independent agency owner. He discusses the benefits of the independent route and the importance of finding a niche in the insurance market. The conversation then shifts to the rise of AI in insurance and the need for insurance professionals to embrace and integrate AI into their businesses.
